[LTIM.12.11] **DST: no wall-clock time is resolved to an instant, so no gap
or overlap arises.** Every resolution goes from an instant to an offset: a
zone is resolved at an instant ([LTIM.10.7]), and `calendar.time` builds a UTC
instant ([LTIM.14.1]). A local time skipped at spring-forward, or repeated at
fall-back, is never read.
What a value that carries an offset does across a transition is [LTIM.7.3]'s.
